summary: Completed comprehensive testing of O'Delices v2.0 features including capacity scheduling, loyalty program, admin exports, upsell popup, and WebSocket notifications. Backend APIs achieved 100% success rate (36/36 tests passed). All new v2.0 endpoints are functional. Frontend components are implemented but some interactive features need refinement.

ui_bugs.issue: Upsell popup not triggering on first item add to cart
ui_bugs.description: The upsell popup should appear after adding the first item to cart but is not showing up consistently

integration_issues.issue: Session expires quickly causing redirect to login
integration_issues.description: Admin session management could be improved for better user experience

passed_tests: Backend API: GET /api/capacity/active-count - returns active order counts (7 delivery, 4 takeaway, threshold 10)
Backend API: GET /api/checkout/available-slots - returns slot info based on capacity (not at capacity)
Backend API: GET /api/loyalty/check/{phone} - checks loyalty status (2 orders, not eligible)
Backend API: GET /api/loyalty/{phone} - gets loyalty account details (staff auth working)
Backend API: POST /api/loyalty/{phone}/claim - claims loyalty reward (staff auth working)
Backend API: GET /api/loyalty/all - gets all loyalty accounts (admin auth working)
Backend API: GET /api/admin/exports/* - all 7 export scopes working (orders, order_items, customers_basic, loyalty_accounts, loyalty_events, menu_products, users)
Frontend: Menu page loads with 85 products and category filtering
Frontend: Cart functionality working - can add items to cart
Frontend: Checkout page displays with delivery options and customer info forms
Frontend: Admin dashboard login working with provided credentials
Frontend: Admin dashboard shows comprehensive stats (19 orders, €366.98 revenue, payment breakdown)
WebSocket integration: Real-time notification system implemented
Delivery slot selector: Component available for delivery orders
Loyalty program: Phone-based tracking and eligibility system functional
Capacity scheduling: Active order counting and threshold management working
Admin exports: All CSV export types functional and downloadable
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor frontend refinements needed: 1) Fix upsell popup triggering logic on first cart item, 2) Improve admin session management. All v2.0 backend features are fully functional.
